# Shared Worlds authentication

Unmodified package source from `manuelk2607/Worlds-Hub`, standalone commit
`b0e6eac7bc6fdd46317dc933a83936c16ecde816`, tag `auth-v0.1.3`.
Installed locally through `file:vendor/worlds-auth`. No private repository
credentials are needed for builds or runtime. This is server-only code;
clients and host-only sessions remain separate per application.
